# bugs #3288: The build prints that makeinfo is missing, and configure does not check for it

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3288/
- Category: [Already fixed in trunk](../../fixed-upstream.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Close with bug #3192, because on r17176 the build and the installation complete without makeinfo. The revision is not identified.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

On r17176 `configure`, `make`, and `make install` complete when makeinfo is not in `PATH`. The test
was run on Debian with a `PATH` that has every program of `/usr/bin` except `makeinfo` and
`texi2any`, and with mcs51 as the only port. The three commands each returned exit status 0, and
`make install` was given a `DESTDIR`. The compiler and the mcs51 libraries were built.

The output of `configure` has `checking for makeinfo... no` from the configure scripts of
`support/cpp` and `support/sdbinutils` and no error. The top-level `configure.ac` has no check for
makeinfo. During `make`, the configure scripts of `libsframe`, `libiberty`, and `libctf` in
`support/sdbinutils` each print a warning that the info documentation will not be built. For
`libctf`, the message from the `missing` script that the ticket quotes precedes this warning.
`support/cpp` builds no info files.

A build with the other ports and a build from a release tarball were not tested. Outside
`support/sdbinutils` and `support/cpp`, the only build files that name makeinfo are the makefiles
of the pic14 and pic16 libraries, which have no Texinfo source.

## Fixed by

The revision was not identified, and no revision before r17176 was built. Bug #3192, which a
maintainer filed in March 2021, states that the build failed without makeinfo. In the trunk of
that month, `support/sdbinutils` has the directory `bfd/doc`, whose makefile calls `$(MAKEINFO)`
for `bfd.info` in the `info` and `install-info` targets.
[r13464](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/13464/), the merge of GNU Binutils 2.38, removed that
directory. Whether that directory caused the failure in 4.1.0 was not determined.

## Related

Bug #3192 asks for a check for makeinfo in `configure`, because the build failed without it. The
result above applies to it as well.
